dam_official_name.source: Central Water Commission (CWC) National Register of Large Dams (NRLD) & Tamil Nadu WRD
dam_official_name.exact_reference: NRLD Dam Index ID: TN12HH0014 (Bhavanisagar / Lower Bhavani)
dam_official_name.definition: Official statutory name of the dam in National Register of Large Dams

dam_type.value: Composite Earthen Dam with Central Masonry Spillway
dam_type.definition: Structural dam type: composite earthfill flanks with central concrete/masonry section

year_completed.definition: Year construction completed and reservoir commissioned

nrld_height_above_lowest_foundation_m.source: Central Water Commission (CWC) National Register of Large Dams 2019 (PIC: TN12HH0014)
nrld_height_above_lowest_foundation_m.exact_reference: NRLD 2019 Height above Lowest Foundation Field (62.0 m)
nrld_height_above_lowest_foundation_m.definition: Height of dam structure above lowest point of foundation in metres (Source A)

nrld_dam_length_m.source: Central Water Commission (CWC) National Register of Large Dams 2019 (PIC: TN12HH0014)
nrld_dam_length_m.exact_reference: NRLD 2019 Length of Dam Field (8797.0 m)
nrld_dam_length_m.definition: Total length of dam structure reported in NRLD 2019 (Source A)

technical_project_dam_length_m.source: Lower Bhavani Project Technical Description & Rehabilitation Engineering Literature
technical_project_dam_length_m.definition: Overall composite dam crest length reported in state technical documentation (Source B)

central_masonry_section_length_m.source: Lower Bhavani Project Technical Description & WRD Engineering Records
central_masonry_section_length_m.exact_reference: Technical Project Description (464.0 m masonry section)
central_masonry_section_length_m.definition: Total length of the central masonry structural section (Source B)

masonry_section_height_from_lowest_found.definition: Height of central masonry section above deepest foundation level (Source B)

earthen_embankment_reported_height_m.exact_reference: Lower Bhavani Project Summary (reported ~40.0 m / 130 ft height above riverbed for embankment flanks)
earthen_embankment_reported_height_m.definition: Reported representative structural height of earthfill embankment flanks above riverbed (distinct from deepest masonry foundation)

arithmetic_embankment_length_approx_m.source: Derived: Technical Total Length (8780.0 m) minus Central Masonry Section (464.0 m) = 8316.0 m
arithmetic_embankment_length_approx_m.definition: Approximate combined embankment length derived by subtraction (not a published survey quantity)

spillway_type.value: Ogee Masonry Spillway with Radial Crest Gates
spillway_type.source: TNWRD Dam Operations Manual & CWC NRLD
spillway_type.exact_reference: TNWRD Lower Bhavani Dam Operations & Maintenance Manual
spillway_type.definition: Spillway discharge crest profile and gate type

spillway_crest_length_m.exact_reference: 9 bays x 10.97 m gate clear width plus intermediate piers = 120.70 m
spillway_crest_length_m.definition: Length of ogee spillway discharge crest (distinct from the 464.0 m central masonry monolith)

spillway_crest_level_m.source: TNWRD Lower Bhavani Dam Operations Manual
spillway_crest_level_m.exact_reference: Spillway Crest Sill Datum (900.0 ft MSL = 274.32 m MSL)
spillway_crest_level_m.definition: Elevation of the ogee spillway crest sill in metres MSL

spillway_capacity_cumec.definition: Total design flood discharge capacity of the 9-bay gated spillway

spillway_gate_count.source: TNWRD Dam Operations Manual & CWC NRLD
spillway_gate_count.exact_reference: TNWRD Spillway Gate Schedule (9 radial gates)
spillway_gate_count.definition: Number of gated spillway crest bays

spillway_gate_size_m.source: TNWRD Lower Bhavani Dam Operations Manual
spillway_gate_size_m.exact_reference: Gate Schedule: 36 ft x 20 ft (10.97 m x 6.10 m)
spillway_gate_size_m.definition: Clear width and height of each radial spillway crest gate

reservoir_frl_m.source: Central Water Commission (CWC) Flood Forecasting & Reservoir Monitoring Records
reservoir_frl_m.exact_reference: CWC Daily Reservoir Bulletin / 2024 Appraisal Report for Bhavanisagar
reservoir_frl_m.definition: Full Reservoir Level in orthometric height metres above Mean Sea Level

reservoir_full_depth_ft.source: Tamil Nadu Water Resources Department (TNWRD) Daily Reservoir Dashboard
reservoir_full_depth_ft.exact_reference: TNWRD Water Year Bulletin & Daily Storage Dashboard (105 ft = 32.004 m)
reservoir_full_depth_ft.definition: Operating water column depth above zero-gauge sill datum

cwc_hydrological_data_book_2020.definition: Central Water Commission Hydrological Data Book 2020 (Cauvery Basin Reservoir Records)

tn_state_feasibility_project_record.definition: Tamil Nadu State Project Feasibility & Operational Storage Schedule (cited as 32.0 TMC operational)

breach_model_vw_m3.source: CWC Hydrological Data Book 2020 live storage record (780.5 MCM)
breach_model_vw_m3.definition: First-estimate active breach volume assumption in absence of dynamic stage-storage routing. NOT observed breachable volume.

final_breach_height_hb_m.exact_reference: SIH PS 26161 Research Prototype Baseline Definition
final_breach_height_hb_m.definition: This is a hypothetical complete-breach depth assumption and is not the published maximum dam height (which is 62.0 m / 62.18 m for the deepest masonry foundation).

preferred_live_storage_for_breach_model.source: Pending physical stage-storage rating curve and surveyed breach invert datum
preferred_live_storage_for_breach_model.definition: Preferred live storage for breach model (kept null pending physical invert routing)

left_embankment_length_m.definition: Length of left embankment flank (individual split unverified in public NRLD)

right_embankment_length_m.definition: Length of right embankment flank (individual split unverified in public NRLD)

official_mwl_m.definition: Maximum Water Level under design flood routing

official_crest_elevation_m.definition: Structural top-of-dam road crest elevation in metres MSL
